preservedResponsibilities: Original concrete UnoComplexColor uses actual WeakImplHelper<XComplexColor>, value-copies ComplexColor and returns signed32 representation/theme/final Color. resolveColor intentionally ignores XTheme and returns stored final color including transparency. Factories acquire actual References and retain the original unchecked static downcast precondition; null alone returns a default ComplexColor, with no fallback for foreign component implementations. Actual shared Type/Any/Reference/Sequence/typelib/OSL owners are reused. TypeScript structural interface casts retain a single object identity; explicit low-level pointer-adjustment callbacks represent compiler casts only. Original LP64 recursive base-offset increments are retained for concrete facet callers; physical C++ object layout/ABI is not certified. Synchronous execution replaces native mutex/barrier syntax. No alternative UNO type registry, runtime inferred interface provider, allocator, fake component or generic exception bridge is introduced. Native aggregation/component/inheritance helper families outside WeakImplHelper and full native reflection remain unported. Six focused cases use actual typelib records and component references; whole-module/native compiled differential parity remains unverified. CellColorHandler, complete DOCX/XLSX model/export and desktop/mobile file UI paths remain incomplete.
